name: qcut
description: Create media and control the QCut desktop video editor from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Create and edit video in QCut
interface.longDescription: Use QCut's structured CLI and visible background Agent pointer to generate and analyze media, transcribe footage, edit timelines, adjust speed curves, record HD demos, and export projects from a running QCut desktop app.
defaultPrompt: Check whether QCut is installed, help me install the official latest release if needed, and open my project on the Media page.
Use QCut to transcribe this video and prepare an editable timeline.
Open my QCut project, inspect the timeline, and make the requested edits or generate media.
Keep my current app focused while the Agent pointer applies and adjusts a video speed curve in QCut.
Check for the latest QCut release and update the app after I confirm.
